full_judgment: "I. Because the High Court Division overlooked the very important aspect of the case that out of 8 defendants only one defendant the defendant No. 6 has denied the compromise petition which is a weighty piece of evidence in favour of plaintiffs' title and possession in the suit land; that the records of right along with rent receipts showing payment of rent for  a long period also gave a presumption of possession in favour of the plaintiffs, but the High Court Division did not consider these valuable evidence also and consequently came to the wrong findings and decision and as such the impugned judgment and order passed by the High Court Division is liable to be set aside."
